text: A form is a character class function that enables or disables certain abilities as well as boosts class performance. Forms most commonly refer to Druid shapeshifting forms. In macros (specifically macro conditionals) and some action bar add-ons, this refers to a variety of forms that classes can adopt, such as Stealth, Shadowform, and Ghost Wolf. "Form" is synonymous with "stance" in macros.

Formal Dangui is a vanity dress item named after the dangui, a type of traditional Korean dress worn during weddings and other ceremonies. This item can be purchased for from Geenia Sunshadow in Moonglade. However, it is a limited supply item with a very long restock time; players often report waiting a matter of weeks before being able to buy it.

The Forgotten Pool is a completely submerged cavern located within Blackfathom Deeps. It was the location of Old Serra'kis, and can be accessed by swimming past the Moonshrine Ruins. The pool is a dead-end, and was only used to battle its now-removed boss. It was used by the Guardian of the Deep as a new lair to spawn its brood, but Horde adventurers laid the beast low before the problem could multiply. After the Fourth War, Rexxar and Zekhan checked the area and confirmed that Ashenvale remains free of the Guardian.

The Forlorn Spirit appears a few times throughout The Legend of Stalvan quest chain. There is a delay when she first appears before she attacks in which you should be able to run away if you do not want to confront her. Oddly, she has a aura, even during combat (noted during Moonbrook encounter.)

.]] The Forgotten Shore is located on the far southeast edge of Dragonblight, between New Hearthglen and the Dragonspine Tributary. The shore is perpetually shrouded with mist. The natural bay is choked with the disintegrating wrecks of ships, the sands littered with shattered, wind-worn wood, and many ghosts wandering aimlessly.

This article lists the locations of forges and anvils throughout Azeroth and Outland. Forges and anvils are needed for most blacksmithing and engineering products. Most forges and anvils are found inside major towns and cities, but these can also sometimes be far out of your way, or right in your area. Outside of towns and cities, there are scattered forges and anvils in small flight point settlements and mob encampments. It can be unpredictable as to where one might find a forge – why Refuge Pointe and not Chillwind Camp? This list was started as a list of fixed devices, which started a list of forges and anvils found in unexpected places. For a list other devicetype see: * Mailboxes

The Forlorn Spire is a monument in eastern Molten Front. Some fire spiders from the Widow's Clutch often wander there. The Shadow Wardens, under the command of Captain Saynna Stormrunner, want to take this piece of land to use as a staging ground against the Druid of the Flames and Ragnaros' elemental forces. During The Forlorn Spire (quest), after killing a Pyrelord, Deldren Ravenelm or Turak Runetotem destroys it with a plant that impales it from below. Its ruins become a forward base for the Shadow Wardens. The Spire resets daily. Unlocking the quests here requires completion of both The Shadow Wardens and The Forlorn Spire (quest).

Forgotten Hill is a cemetery on the southwestern coast of the Tol Barad Peninsula. Ever since Alliance and Horde troops returned to the island, it has been overrun with ghouls and zombies. It is one of the largest known cemeteries in Azeroth.

According to the ogres, the Forgers were the great beings who shaped the world of Draenor and created the ogre race. When the Forgers squeezed the light from the enormous ball of fire that would become Draenor, they made the ogres from the same smoking clay and gave them dominion over stone and earth, making the ogres the rightful rulers of Draenor. The ogres consider their magic to derive from the Forgers.
Forever Rise is an area in southern Azsuna overlooking the Oceanus Cove. Here ghosts are attending a wedding for eternity.
The Forgotten Approach connects the Terrace of the Moon with the Lair of Harjatan and Sunken Stair.
Former Interns are oozelings found on Alcaz Island in Dustwallow Marsh.
Forge of Light is an active racial ability for all lightforged draenei, summoning a Forge of Light acting as an anvil and allowing the use of Blacksmithing.

The Forgeguard are a unit of Dark Iron dwarf soldiers loyal to Moira Thaurissan, Queen-Regent of the Dark Iron clan, and the city of Ironforge. Shortly before the Siege of Orgrimmar, the Forgeguard accompanied Moira into the battle against the Frostmane trolls of Shimmer Ridge. During the Battle for Stromgarde, Dark Iron Forge-Guards can be seen among Muradin Bronzebeard's forces.
Forge Hammers are sold for by Garo Driftpelt and Forgus Anvilrage during Island Expeditions.

The Forgotten Lodge is an unassuming cottage owned by House Waycrest in Drustvar, on the Alpine Rise. Its purpose is to conceal the entrance to Gol Var, ancient Drust ruins built in the mountain, and the hiding place of the Tome of Silver and Ash, the compiled knowledge of the Order of Embers. The true nature of this area has been passed down through House Waycrest for thousands of years.
Forged in Flames is a passive racial ability for all Dark Iron dwarves, reducing physical damage taken.

The Forge of the Roaring Mountain is the artifact forge for monks of the Order of the Broken Temple, situated in the Temple of Five Dawns on the Wandering Isle. The forge itself consists of the head of the statue of Shen-zin Su.
Forgotten Cove is the shoreline of the Shrine of the Storm island in Stormsong Valley.
The Forgotten Retreat is one of the remote islands off the western end of Ardenweald. Marasmius sends players here on occasion after unlocking Tier 3 of the transportation network in Go Beyond!.
Form of Darkness is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Forging Worlds: Stories Behind the Art of Blizzard Entertainment is a book based on material from the Blizzard Entertainment universes.
The Forgotten Pump is found in the Untamed Verdure in Zereth Mortis. It can be activated with the Dangerous Orb of Power in order to pull the Submerged Chest up to the surface.

The Forsaken Courier is a level 35 Forsaken who is sent by Apothecary Jorell from the Go'Shek Farm in the Arathi Highlands to Tarren Mill in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Before the Shattering, she was usually escorted by four level 35 Forsaken Bodyguards. Quae wants the documents that the courier carries.
Formula: Enchant Gloves - Fire Power drops from any boss in Ahn'Qiraj.
Forsaken Commoners are Forsaken located in the center of Undercity.
Forsaken Raiders were Forsaken workers busy away at work demolishing a scout tower southwest of the Horde town of Tarren Mill. The raiders have the ability to go stealth.

Forsaken High Command, part of the Forsaken Front, is a subzone of Silverpine Forest and is the first quest hub players will run across after their adventures in Tirisfal Glades. The entire series of phased quests for the zone begins here with none other than Lady Sylvanas Windrunner personally overseeing the effort to rekindle the Forsaken as a race. During The Warchief Cometh, Garrosh Hellscream and High Warlord Cromush make an appearance here. You will need to complete this in order to make the flightmaster and other vendors appear. On the way here from Tirisfal Glades, players will witness Dreadguards marching up and down the zone as well as pass by Forsaken Troopers and Forsaken Apothec

Forsaken Forward Command is the main Horde outpost in the Ruins of Gilneas, located right along the Greymane Wall, extending from the gate in all directions into the peninsula. It has a flight master for those who obtain the quest To Forsaken Forward Command, where Horde players are transported to the front lines by the val'kyr Arthura. However, the outpost only lasts until Fall Back!, when it is overrun by the Gilneas Liberation Front worgen; Arthura will transport players back to Silverpine Forest in The Great Escape. While the outpost lasts, it is under constant attack by Worgen Rushers from the Gilneas Liberation Front. Following the retreat, a group of Worgen Rushers will be standing ar

__NOTOC__ Forsaken Catapults are part of the Forsaken forces storming the beach at Duskmist Shore in Gilneas. Piloted by s, they are bombarding the nearby farmsteads. Within this subzone they are considered . Later, they are units hurling barrels of the plague into Gilneas City from the Northern Headlands.

Forsaken Plaguesmiths are servants of working to produce vast quantities of the plague to use against Gilneas City. When not working at their vats, they are accompanied by multiple s, walking the main road of the Northern Headlands up to the Greymane Wall.

Forsaken Guards guard Windrunner's Sanctuary, the Horde district of Dalaran. They are hostile to Alliance players, and will teleport any of them away if approached. They replaced the Sunreaver Guardian Mages.
Formula: Chaos Shatter is a reputation reward; you must be with the Argussian Reach to purchase this item from Toraan the Revered on the Vindicaar for .

Forsaken Battleguards are guards found atop Dazar'alor in the Great Seal area. They are also on the Banshee's Wail. After Zul betrayed Rastakhan, several of them killed the Zanchuli Betrayers that appeared in the Great Seal. They briefly appear in Zuldazar, being targeted by the Alliance. They are also seen aboard a ship on the Great Sea.

Forsaken Priests took part in the War of the Thorns, appearing at Zoram'gar Outpost in Ashenvale and then in Darkshore. During the final phase, they fought against the night elves stationed at Mist's Edge west of Lor'danel, and later gathered with the Horde army to witness the Burning of Teldrassil. Following the Burning, they remained in Lor'danel. One priest could be seen defiling the moonwell there.
Forsaken Generals are Forsaken located in Cathedral Square in Gilneas City.
The Formless Dreadsaddle was never made available. It would grant the Dreadsaddle anima power.
Formless Executioner is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

The Forsaken Dreadmage is a Forsaken standing next to Calia Menethil in the Enclave in Oribos and in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar. During Calia's mission to aid the Forsaken against the blight, the Dreadmage opened a portal in Brill to Maldraxxus. Once the Forsaken reclaimed the Ruins of Lordaeron, the Dreadmage is seen channeling a Portal to Howling Fjord.
Formula: Enchant Cloak - Regenerative Leech is sold by Murik and Rokkutuk in the Azure Span for .
Formula: Magically Regulated Automa Core is sold by Olea Manu in Zereth Mortis for .
Formula: Ley Shatter is sold by Ildine Sorrowspear in Dalaran for .

Foulspore Cavern is located inside Maraudon, and is the first area beyond the instance portal in the orange tunnels. It stretches past the Noxious Hollow to the Poison Falls, and is the location of the giant lasher Razorlash. It is a physically corrupted part of the dungeon, showing signs of putridity, disease, and toxicity. Besides lashers, corrupt dryads, maggots and oozes also thrive here.
The Fourth Company was part of the forces defending Stormwind City during the First War.
This item is crafted with Inscription, via the Darkmoon Card of the North recipe.
Forsaken Refugees were Forsaken found on the outskirts of Orgrimmar when the Undercity was controlled by Varimathras and Putress.
Fox Poops are located in the Lakeridge Highway in the Redridge Mountains. This poop might be of Redridge Foxes as they are the only fox type in the area of the poop.

Forsaken Rear Guard is a Forsaken base located between Forsaken High Command and the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. A large contingent of Orgrimmar sea forces has recently arrived here, and they appear to enjoy their alcohol. Orc Sea Dogs can be found throughout the area. Before the Shattering the area was known as the Dead Field.

Fossil Archaeology Fragments are found using the Survey ability of the Archaeology skill. As with all Archaeology Fragments, they are not inventory items but instead tracked on the relevant page of a player's archaeology dialog. These fragments are found at Fossil archaeology sites.

Forsaken Troopers are Forsaken troops found throughout Silverpine Forest. A number of new troopers are raised via the Val'kyr's necromantic powers, as seen on Fenris Isle and the Battle for Andorhal. A group of them go through Pyrewood Village and the Battlefront, entering the Ruins of Gilneas through the Greymane Wall.

A Fountain of Mana is a neutral (not belonging to any specific player teams) building in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos and its expansion the Frozen Throne. Units with less than maximum mana (given that they are units that use mana) that is standing close to it will regenerate mana faster than normally.

A Fountain of Health is a neutral (not belonging to any specific player teams) building in Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos and its expansion The Frozen Throne. Wounded units standing close to it will regenerate faster than normally, which makes it useful for healing.

Forsaken Survivors are all that remains of the Forsaken forces that attempted to storm the beach at Duskmist Shore in Gilneas. They are scattered throughout the waters lapping along the shattered remains of the Allen Farmstead, attempting to thwart those that would save the valiant .
Four Square is a player vs. player achievement earned for holding all four Orbs of Power at least once in a single Temple of Kotmogu battle.
__NOTOC__ Foxflower Flux is a quest reward from Nature Provides. This item is also sold by the following vendors: *Imindril Spearsong in Dalaran *Thala Steeltotem in Highmountain *Urael in Suramar
Forsaken Sergeants are Forsaken located in the Cathedral Quarter of Gilneas City in Gilneas.
Foulwing Swarmers are felbats located in Azsuna and Highmountain during Legion Assaults.
Fortitude of the Cenarion Circle is a Guardian druid artifact trait. It is linked to the Scintillating Moonlight (artifact trait) trait.

The Foul Manifestation is a sludge ooze located in the Heaps on Mechagon Island. When the ooze is away, the area is inspected by a Grease Prospector and his Grease Pail. The location of the ooze houses three pylons: *Alpha Pylon *Beta Pylon *Delta Pylon
Foulshriek is a skeletal bird of prey who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
The Four Dons was based out of Stormwind City. In his younger days, Rohan the Assassin was one of them, along with Don Julio and two more unknown members.
Forsworn Feather is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Fortified Leg Braces is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Fossilized Bone Fragments is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Forsworn Aquilon is an aquilon flying mount, rewarded from Intact Aquilon Core, which is started from the Intact Aquilon Core (item) rarely dropped by the Wild Worldcracker at the end of the Popo's Potion Patrol vignette in central Korthia.
Forward Assault Camp is a located on the island of the Hollowed Out Tree in Townlong Steppes. It is acessed through the Rear Staging Area.
Four of Putrescence is a reagent for Darkmoon Deck: Putrescence.
__NOTOC__ Franklin Lloyd is a Forsaken artisan engineering trainer located in the Rogues' Quarter in the Undercity.
Franklin Hamar is a human tailoring vendor located in the Lakeshire Inn in the Redridge Mountains.

Fragmented Magic is the final step in a mage-only quest line to obtain the spell Polymorph: Pig. This rank of Polymorph is mechanically the same as Polymorph (Rank 4) except the target is transformed into a pig instead of a sheep.

Frayfeather Hippogryphs are hippogryphs found in the Frayfeather Highlands in Feralas. The troll Witch Doctor Uzer'i sends out members of the Horde to collect Metallic Fragments and Resilient Sinews that these beasts carry, and he also tasks adventurers with capturing their spirits as Hippogryph Muisek. Frayfeathers are known as excellent flyers. They hatch annually on February 23.
Frankal Stonebridge is a dwarf quest giver located at Bronzebeard Encampment in Silithus. He vanishes after Sargeras destroys Silithus and it is unknown if he survived the attack.
Fragrant Flowers is the name of a flower shop located in the Canal District in Stormwind City. It sits at the end of the canal between the Trade District and Old Town, on the Trade District side.
The Fragrant Cauldron can be found behind Ravenholdt Manor in Alterac Mountains.
Frax Bucketdrop is a goblin flight master located at Thondroril River in the Eastern Plaguelands.

__NOTOC__ Frazzlecraz Motherlode is a Horde goblin mining operation found near the quilboar in the Southern Barrens, just west of Bael Modan. After discovering his son's death, destruction of his keep and a goblin corpse at the scene of the crime, General Twinbraid believed that the Horde was responsible for Bael Modan's destruction. As the new military leader in the Southern Barrens, he plans to destroy the mine and annihilate its workers to get revenge.
__NOTOC__ Franny Mertz is a Forsaken flight master located at Forsaken Rear Guard in Silverpine Forest.

The Fragment of Anguish is a keystone used by the to allow entry through the magical barrier of Anguish Fortress, while keeping it sealed to outsiders at the same time. Former elder Rulkan kept at least one when her exiles broke away from the clan. Due to the deep respect she shared with Prophet Velen, Rulkan gave her fragment to the Alliance commander sent by Velen in order to help the draenei people and stop .
While on the quest Tools of the Trade you can find Shattered Burial Urn to start this side-quest.
Fragments of Uul are located in Highmountain. They are summoned by the Shadow of the Darkness.
Franklin is a mastiff located in Redridge Pass in Redridge Mountains during Tracking Tipoff. If Hunter McAlister‎ is killed first, Franklin runs away.
Fractured Personality Modules drop from mobs on Mechagon Island.
Fragments of Zem'lan's Lost Treasure Map are rewarded from Island Expeditions. Combining 15 of them creates Zem'lan's Lost Treasure Map.
Free T-Shirts are shot out in the streets of Stormwind City and Orgrimmar by the Stormwind Entertainer and the Orgrimmar Entertainer.
Foxicopter is summoned by Foxicopter Controller. One is flying at Nesingwary's Safari in the Valley of the Four Winds.
The Fractured Obsidian Claw teaches you how to summon Muar, an obsidian destroyer companion.
__NOTOC__ Frazzle Frostfingers is a gnome mage trainer located in the Training Hall in Stormwind City.
Fractured Phantasma Lure is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned. The damage penalty can be removed with Reinforced Lure Casing.
Fragments of Obscurity is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Fractured Bone Shards is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Fragments of the Elder Antlers is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Fragments of the Elder Antlers.
Fracturing Rumblers are earth elementals located on Dragonskull Island in the Forbidden Reach.
Fraggel is a goblin located at Zen'shiri Trading Post in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar.

The Fragmented Hakkari Bijou is found beside a gong in the room full of Twisted Spirits beneath the Altar of the Blood God in Zul'Gurub. It can only be looted while in the Spirit Realm during Jin'do the Godbreaker's encounter. This item can be combined with a Shattered Hakkari Bijou to create a Restored Hakkari Bijou.
Freed Emberstone Villagers are humans located in Gilneas City.
The Fractures in Time campaign covers all quests added in patch 10.1.5 as part of the Dragonflight campaign.

Freewind Post is a Horde town located high on a mesa in Thousand Needles. Tauren settlements in Thousand Needles are constructed atop the tall mesas in the region, staying out of reach of the centaur warbands that have several camps in the area. The village on the mesa's top is accessible by the employment of the ingenious wooden lifts of the tauren, although there is a series of rope bridges spanning amongst the adjacent pinnacles, gradually working their way to the top. The tauren of Freewind Post work to stop the activity of the Galak tribe centaur in Thousand Needles. Screeching harpies pose a less dire threat to the stability of the region as well. Another large aspect of the society of
]] Freezing Trap is a level 10 hunter ability. This trap offers long-duration crowd control that breaks on damage. Hunters who start in Exile's Reach unlock this by completing A Hunter's Trap.
Frenzied Regeneration is a druid talent. It is a handy self-heal for druids in Bear Form. It is automatically learned for Guardian druids.

Friendly Dalaran Wizards are scattered throughout Dalaran proper (not the Underbelly). They have a wide variety of names, and they serve the purpose of helping lost players find their way by providing directions to many locations in the city.

Frenzyheart River is a river in Sholazar Basin that starts from Wintergrasp flowing past the destroyed Lifeblood Pillar and Frenzyheart Hill and merging with Rainspeaker Rapids before finally ending at River's Heart.
artwork.]] Freezing Arrow is a hunter ability which can place a Freezing Trap at a distance.
Friends In Even Higher Places is a Feat of Strength earned by obtaining the X-53 Touring Rocket mount through the Recruit-A-Friend program.
Frightened Citizens are human fleeing for their lives in the Merchant Square of Gilneas City. They flee out of their home when you knock on their door.
Frightened Chickens are critters running loose in Merchant Square in Gilneas City.
Freshwater Eels are eels located in the western part of Lake Everstill in Redridge Mountains.
Frenzied Crocolisks are crocolisks found in Lost City of the Tol'vir.

Frightened Miner are Alliance human miners inhabiting the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains. They are located near the Alliance entrance of the mine, often hiding in corners and mining carts. They are unattackable by Horde, and will not attack. Many of them are found dead.

Frightened Peons are level 19 - 21 Horde orc peons inhabiting the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains. They are located near the Horde entrance of the mine, often hiding in corners and mining carts. They are unattackable by Alliance, and will not attack.
Frenzyheart Visitors are visitors that occasionally appear in the VIP section of the Darkmoon Faire Zoo.
__NOTOC__ Frenzied Stalkers are worgen found in the Light's Dawn Cathedral in Gilneas City during the quest Last Stand (quest).
Frenzyheart Brew is an ability used by Curious Wolvar Pup during a Pet Battle.
Fresh-Squeezed Limeade can be purchased for (stack of 5) from at the Darkmoon Faire.
Friends In Places Higher Yet is a Feat of Strength earned by obtaining the Heart of the Nightwing mount through the Recruit-A-Friend program.
Friends In Places Even Higher Than That is a feats of strength achievement earned for obtaining an Emerald Hippogryph through the Recruit-A-Friend program.

The Frenzied Golem is found at in Liadrin's Watch, between and in central Talador. Having already killed several Sunsworn Defenders, it is kept at bay by the remaining blood elves stationed at the camp. It has the Diablo III-like affixes of Vortex, Arcane Enchanted, and Dampening. As a refresher for people who have not played Diablo III recently, those affixes are: * * ** * Once defeated, the frenzied golem drops the Shard of Contempt (dagger) (for intellect users) or the Shard of Scorn (for agility/strength users) and 10-20 Garrison Resources.

__NOTOC__ Frightened Laborers are nightborne found in the Gilded Market of Suramar City in Suramar. On Ruven's orders, they are harassed to a Gondola by Duskmere Smugglers in order to be fuel for a soul engine.
Freya's Spring Water can be obtained from Freya's Spring: The Mountain King.
Freyja is the pet wolf of Ranger Wain, located at Trueshot Lodge in Highmountain.
Frenzied Plaguewings are felbats located in the Shattered Fields in Krokuun.
Friends In Places Yet Even Higher Than That is a feats of strength achievement earned for obtaining a Cindermane Charger through the Recruit-A-Friend program.
Freshwater Longfins are eels located in the waters below Thunder Totem and at the Sylvan Falls in Highmountain.
Frenzied Wildhearts are worgen who can be encountered during Island Expeditions.
Frenzied Deep Sea Makrura are makrura located in the Abyssal Maw during Throne of the Tides: Azshara's Power.
Frenzied Deep Sea Crawlers are crabs located in Abyssal Maw during Throne of the Tides: Azshara's Power.
Frenzywing is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Frenzy Imbued Azerite is an Azerite elemental oozeling located in Island Expeditions.
Frenzyband is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Frenzyband.
Freezing Winds is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of the Freezing Winds.
Frenzied Monstrosity is a runecarving power obtained from Memory of a Frenzied Monstrosity.
Fresh Catches can be found on Island Expeditions. It heals adventurers for 10% of their max health.
Frenzied Caterpillars are silkworms located in the Widow's Wail in the Jade Forest. They sometimes spawn from destroyed Widow's Web.
Friends In Feathers is a quest achievement earned by rescuing the following moonkin hatchlings during the "Claws For Concern" quest in the Whorlwing Basin.

]] Frogs are a common amphibian species found in Azeroth, Outland, and Bonich. Some species of frog can feast upon prey several times larger than themselves by slowly digesting the victim externally with a toxic slime. Ale frogs were thought to have been extinct until the strange brews at the Darkmoon Faire brought them out of hiding. The rumors of the medicinal uses of the biletoad were believed to have been started by a particularly mischievous apothecary. Orcish children have a tradition where they sneak up on a mud jumper and whisper a secret they wish to come true. If the mud jumper doesn't jump, the wish will come true. The swamps of Zandalar are home to large dire toads which are the
Frost Nova is a level 3 mage ability. On use, it deals light damage and freezes nearby enemies, rooting them. Targets are considered Frozen while affected by Frost Nova.
Permanently enchant gloves to increase frost spell power by 9. Enchanting Level Required: 300
__NOTOC__ .]] Frost Resistance Aura is a Holy paladin ability.

The Frost Ram was a summonable epic mount that was originally purchasable. When the epic mounts were retooled, the ability to purchase this was lost, and anyone willing to do so was able to exchange it with a new mount by accepting and completing the Frost Ram Exchange quest.

Frost resistance is useful in Naxxramas and PvP and vs. some undead mobs that have frost powers. In BC, many of the naga casters use frost spells. The first boss in Serpentshrine Cavern required one tank with heavy frost resistance and two with at least some.

The Frostbridge, named by the tuskarr, spans the Westrift to connect the island of Coldarra to the Borean Tundra and the rest of Northrend. It is narrow, but more than one hundred feet across, and arcs slightly. The top is rough to provide purchases, and has a small lip along the edges, enough to keep travelers from walking unknowing off the bridge but not enough to stop someone from being pushed. Blue dragons watch the bridge at all times and stop travelers from crossing without declaring their names and intentions. The nearby tuskarr that named the bridge have a tale as to why the dragons built it. It says at some point a few centuries back, a human came to Coldarra to see Malygos. This ma

The Frostbrood are elite frost wyrms raised from the bones of blue dragons at Sindragosa's Fall. They consist of whelps, drakes (vanquishers), and the mighty wyrms themselves. The Scourge raised a few ancient and powerful proto-dragons to become members of the brood as well. After the Lich King awoke from his long dormancy, he journeyed to Sindragosa's Fall where he raised the ancient dragon Sindragosa, the first consort to Malygos, as a frost wyrm. His final desecration of Sindragosa was to tear the spirits of her lost whelps into undeath in front of her skeletal form, as a final affront to the great dragon, and then ordered her to lead the Frostbrood into war. Later during the conflict, Si
__NOTOC__ Frostbrood Matriarchs are frost wyrms found flying at The Conflagration in Icecrown.
__NOTOC__ Frostbrood Sentry are frost wyrms found in the Valley of Lost Hope in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.

The Frost Queen's Lair (a.k.a. Sindragosa's Lair) is a large area found within the Icecrown Citadel where all the Frostbrood dragonflight appear in. It is the place where Rimefang, Spinestalker and Sindragosa are found.
Frost Breath is one of the pet abilities that only chimaeras can use.
Frost Spit is an ability used by penguins during a Pet Battle.
Friz Groundspin is a goblin flight master located at Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara. He has a gyrocopter.
Frolick is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
The Frostboar Drifts is the western plains of Frostfire Ridge where the Coldsnout Boars roam. This is also home to the powerful Garn breed of wolves.
Frizzo's Fingertrap enhances Carve and Lacerate (hunter ability).

The Frost flayers are the only known species of rock flayer located on alternate Draenor. They are located on an Island southwest off Frostfire Ridge. Modern anthropologists had hoped Draenor would reveal the origin of the rock flayer. They were disappointed.
The Frost-Imbued Gem is one of four gems used to power the barrier blocking off Xylem's Tower in Azshara.
Frost Flayer Hatchlings are rock flayers located on Rock Flayer Island in the Colossal Depths in Frostfire Ridge.
Frost Flayers are frost flayers located on Rock Flayer Island in the Colossal Depths in Frostfire Ridge.
Frizzle Smashcash is a goblin located at the Western Spray on Mechagon Island.
Frostbite Wand is an anima power obtained from the Anima Cell left behind after defeating the Seeker of Souls in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Frigid Wildseed is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
__NOTOC__ Frostbrood Proto-Wyrm is a proto-dragon flying mount.
__NOTOC__ Frostbrood Whelps are dragon whelps found at Sindragosa's Fall in Icecrown. Empowered versions appeared during Death Rising.

Frostwolf Keep is the base of operations for the Frostwolf Clan, located at the base of the mountains in southern Alterac Valley. This Horde stronghold is where General Drek'Thar rules the Frostwolf Clan and directs the Horde war effort. The Alliance's Stormpike Guard must battle their way from Dun Baldar in the Northern Valley through the Horde's tower defenses in order to reach the inner sanctum of the Frostwolf command structure. A lot has been made of a design problem in the keep. While the Horde must fight their way though almost all of Dun Baldar to reach the Stormpike Aid Station, the Alliance can take a shortcut off the road, and bypass Frostwolf's garrison. Frostmane Hold was once the base camp of the Frostmane ice trolls located in the western edge of the cold mountains of Dun Morogh south of Gnomeregan and New Tinkertown. The hold is comprised of a few buildings and a cave system. The Cataclysm tore open deep caves beneath the Hold and as such allowed Rockjaw troggs to drive out the ice trolls, ruled by Boss Bruggor. The trolls who once resided here have fallen back to Frostmane Retreat. Prior to the Cataclysm, young dwarves and gnomes were tasked to explore the caves and report back to Kharanos, in order to determine just how big a threat the trolls were. The area was heavily guarded by troll headhunters and hideskinners. Now, Kharmarn Paleg

Frostfire Hot Springs are a series of steaming pools at the far western end of Winterspring. Donova Snowden, who has set up a camp nearby, is very curious about the reasons they appeared in the icy land and what power they hold. She theorizes that perhaps they came to be from demonic interference stemming from Darkwhisper Gorge far south in Winterspring. This is also a good place to fish for Raw Nightfin Snappers and Plated Armorfish, though the area is inhabited by the Winterfall tribe. After the Cataclysm, the eastern-most pool was invaded by Scalding Springsurges and Boiling Springbubbles. The Winterfall tribe still remains in control of the pool closest to Timbermaw Hold.
Frostmaw was a level 37 yeti found in the Alterac Mountains. He could only be summoned by placing a Fresh Carcass on the Flame of Uzel. Melor Stonehoof wanted Frostmaw's Mane.

On the surface of the Abyssal Maw, at the point farthest from Deepholm, there is a mile-wide shelf of solid ice known as the Frostland. Like an immense iceberg, the Frostland extends far underneath the surface, almost to the ocean floor. Smaller chunks of ice break free occasionally and drift across the seas, slowly melting as they come nearer to Deepholm. Some of these bergs are occupied by ice elemental conglomerates or other creatures.
Frostmaw's Mane drops from Frostmaw in the Ruins of Alterac in Alterac Mountains.
Frostfire Bolt is a mage ability, learned at level 75. It deals direct Frostfire damage and slows the target by 40% for 8 seconds.
Froststorm Breath is one of the pet abilities that only chimeras can use. It deals a small amount of Nature damage and slows the target's movement speed.

The Frostpaw tribe is a tribe of polar furbolgs located in the Grizzly Hills of Northrend. For thousands of years, these furbolgs have lived in peace within the city of Grizzlemaw with the other furbolg tribes, until corruption spread among them. Now driven with madness, they wage war with the Redfang tribe to seek control of Grizzlemaw.

Frostsabre is an island inhabited by dragons. They offer their assistance to any bold enough to prove their worthiness. It is rumored that the dragons' breath is colder than the grave. The tileset is called "Lordaeron Winter".

Frostfloe Deep is a large cave in the North East Corner of the Storm Peaks region, located northwest of Camp Tunka'lo. Since ancient times it has been used as a burial place for Taunka warriors and chieftains, and contains many Taunka relics. Recently, it has been corrupted by a malevolent force that seeks to rewrite the history of the Taunka, sending raging elementals into the once peaceful caverns. The immortal sends you to Frostfloe Deep to question the spirit of Chieftain Swiftspear about Memories of Stormhoof in an attempt to determine what is happening there.

__NOTOC__ Frostilicus is a named unbound water elemental found within Frostwhisper Gorge in Winterspring. According to the quest "Damn You, Frostilicus" (see below), he is the leader of the water elementals that now occupy Frostwhisper Gorge. They seeped from the ground when the earth shook and the bridge collapsed (probably due to the shattering), forcing away the ice giants that previously lived there. He is rather large and uses a number of frost spells.

The Frostmane Front is an area controlled by the Frostmane ice trolls just west of the Frostmane Retreat in Dun Morogh. They're under attack by the nearby dwarves trying to push them back before they claim more land. A group of siege engines and mortar teams support the dwarven riflemen while destroyed ballistae and steam tanks can be seen, being scavenged by the trolls. During the Legion Invasions, the area was invaded by the demons.
Frostflower is a pandaren located at the Shrine of Seven Stars.

:Frostfire Ridge is a harsh land of ceaseless winter and volcanic peaks, where travelers encounter molten lava as often as painfully cold snow. Rock-hewn Bladespire Fortress, built to grandiose heights by the ogres who occupy its halls, is one of the few structures able to remain standing amidst this inhospitable wilderness. It's the perfect target for the survivalist orcs of the Frostwolf clan. :"Like the great wolves that roam here, we survive in this land according to its rules." :— Frostfire Ridge is a zone in north-western . It is home to the Frostwolf clan and the . The ogre stronghold-turned Horde capital, Bladespire Citadel is located here. When Draenor shattered and became Outland,

The Frostwolf Orcs, or Frostwolf clan, are renowned for their prowess as one-on-one combatants. Led by Chieftain Durotan, they are a strong, close-knit clan whose bond with wolves only adds to their strength—though their numbers remain smaller than most clans. Though the clan spends much of their time in Frostfire Ridge, they migrate to with the seasons. In the past, the clan battled against the Laughing Skull clan.

Frostwall Tavern is a medium garrison building that gives Horde players access to unique quests that reward various vanity and useful items, treasure hunter missions, and the ability to recruit followers each week based on what the player is looking for. The Alliance equivalent is the Lunarfall Inn.

Frostwind Crag is a valley in northwestern Frostfire Ridge. It's around here that two Frostwolf villages were located along with their burial grounds. Throm'var is the only Frostwolf village still intact, while the other was destroyed by the . Beneath the valley is the Sleeper's Lair where the pale orcs have awakened an ancient creature. The Frost Den is also found here.
The Frostcrag are a group of drogbar inhabiting Highmountain. They serve as antagonists for Revenge, Served Cold (quest).
Frostfire Augur Signet is a quest reward from WANTED: Gutsmash the Destroyer.
Frostchipper is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Frosthill Giant is a stone giant located in the Dread Chain in Island Expeditions.
Frostscale Broodmother is a hydra located in Island Expeditions.
The Frosthoof Waistcord is an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Jorundall Salvage.
The Frosthoof Gloves are an Island Expedition reward. The item can also be contained in Jorundall Salvage.
Frostclutch Whelps are frost wyrm whelps flying around near the ceiling in the Heart of Acherus in the Broken Isles version of the Ebon Hold.

The Frozen Throne was the receptacle of the soul of the Elder Shaman Ner'zhul following his transformation into the dreaded Lich King. It stood atop a tall spire within a vast chamber of ice, and was described as a diamond-hard block. At the end of the Ascension of the Lich King, King Arthas Menethil entered the Throne Chamber, ascended the spire, shattered that ice with Frostmourne and made it into a much more literal throne. After the throne chamber collapsed and Arthas merged with Ner'zhul to become the new Lich King, he used the remnants of the Frozen Throne as the place from which he commanded the Scourge. While the Lich King slept, Icecrown Citadel was built around the spire.
Frostwoven Power is a cloth uncommon crafted set from the Wrath of the Lich King. It is crafted by Tailoring and intended for Priests.
Frozen Power is a shaman talent, available at level 30. It causes Frost Shock to root the target for 5 sec.
Frozo the Renowned is a gnome on a flying carpet outside the Forge of Fate in Dalaran.

Fulmination is a passive specialization ability for Elemental shamans, available at level 20. It causes Lightning Bolt and Chain Lightning to generate additional Lightning Shield charges, consumed by Earth Shock to deal damage.
Fun for the Little Ones is a monthly quest that can be completed during Darkmoon Faire. You must have 75 archaeology skill to complete.

The bag of Frozen Supplies is nestled in a nook at near ground level on one of the ruined towers northeast of Owl Wing Thicket in southeastern Winterspring. It is only visible to players who have completed Bringing the Bass at their garrison and contains Music Roll: Mountains.
Frozen Mists are unbound air elementals located in Highmountain.
The Frosty Treasure Chest can be found in the mountains between Tiragarde Sound and Stormsong Valley. The chest is located just below the camp of Cynthia Cloudwhisper and the other kite adventurers.
Fungalmancers are casters using fungi and spores. They are able to use their magic to plague areas. Known fungalmancers are found in the ranks of stone troggs and fungarians.

Fungal Behemoths are fungal giants that can be found throughout the Crimson Expanse in Deepholm. Their skin has "gone soft" due to the magic of the stone troggs, and the Stone Lord, fears the infection will spread unless they are killed.

Frozen Mountaineers are dwarves trapped in Icy Tombs at Helm's Bed Lake in Dun Morogh. They were sent by Sergeant Bahrum to keep agitated water elementals at the lake busy, but most have been frozen in blocks of ice.
Full Team Repair is an ability used by battle pets during a Pet Battle.
Functional Fiddleswitches are looted from Mechanized Chests and Mechanized Supply Chests on Mechagon Island.
Fungal Destroyers are sylvar located in the Stalks in Ardenweald.
Funeral Prayer Beads are sold for by Moof during Island Expeditions.
Frozenhorn Rampager is a wendigo located in Island Expeditions.

Fungrets are creatures located in Maldraxxus and Ardenweald. Within Maldraxxus, they are primarily found within Glutharn's Decay, and hate the House of Rituals, presumably for imprisoning and killing them. In Ardenweald, above ground one can grow Humon'gozz, but within the Underweald below the zone, some fungrets are being corrupted by magic from the Maw and are trying to kidnap Princess Penicilla of the Mushroom Kingdom.
Furen Longbeard is a dwarf quest giver located in the Dwarven District in Stormwind City. He was taught by Grimand Elmore.

Funny Bunny's Egg Hunt was one of the official non-melee Warcraft III maps. It was originally released as a downloadable bonus map for Easter 2004, and was later added to the built-in maps through a patch. You play as a bunny, based on the furbolg model but with a cigar, who needs to collect easter eggs on Bunny Island. You are constantly running from "evil bunnies" and trying to catch up to the Easter Bunny.
__NOTOC__ Furnan Skysoar is a dwarf gryphon flight master located at Allerian Stronghold in Terokkar Forest.
__NOTOC__ Furgu is a draenei hippogryph flight master located at Telaar in Nagrand.
Further Conversions is part of the Shattered Sun Offensive storyline. Once players have recovered the Sun's Reach Sanctum, this quest replaces Erratic Behavior.
Furious Gladiator's Totem of Indomitability is an epic relic item for shamans, obtained through PvP.
Furious Gladiator's Idol of Tenacity is an epic relic item for druids, obtained through PvP.
Furious Stone Spirits are earth elementals located in Stonetalon Mountains.

Furgus Warpwood is an ancient of lore located in the Warpwood Quarter in Dire Maul. It is requesting aid to drive out the creatures that have taken over Warpwood Quarter, from Telaron Windflight and Hadoken Swiftstrider.
Fungus Among Us is a daily cooking quest available from Eunice Burch in the Trade Quarter in Undercity.

Furies is the name for all elementals on Draenor, all of whom try to keep the world in balance. Furies appear to be unique to Draenor. It may be something about the primal nature of the planet. After the destruction of Draenor, many furies disappeared, but they are still plentiful on the alternate Draenor. There, the elements live in purity upon the Elemental Plateau. This purity is maintained through the Cycle of Rebirth. Impurities are accumulated in the elemental body over time, and when enough contamination has taken place, an elemental will become unstable and in some cases volatile. When the Elemental Plateau becomes unstable, the cycle of rebirth must begin. A part of the rebirth is p
Funk Golems are broken arcane golems located in the Auction House of the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar during the blood elf round of the Auction House Dance Party.
Furious Spirits is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Furious Bite is one of the pet abilities that only Wolves can use.

The Furbolg Monk is a furbolg used in the Blizzard Warcraft III 'Monolith'. Because of the power of the Monolith which has been attracting wildlife with its mysterious energies, it allows a Furbolg Monk to gather gold and build Furbolg Monasteries. A Furbolg Monk is the lowest level of wolf in Warcraft III costing One food and 50 gold and is classified as a worker. A Furbolg Monk can build Furbolg Monasteriss allowing it to Furbolg monks attempt to divine great secrets and Monolith Shards, becoming the Furbolgs only form of defensive structure. The appearance of Furbolg monks is like a common Furbolg, but much smaller.

G'Hanir, also called the Mother Tree and the Great Bough, is the domain of the Wild God Aviana. It is located in the Emerald Dream and is the tallest tree, atop the tallest peak, with its fruit containing the seeds of all Azerothian trees. It serves as an afterlife for all winged creatures of Azeroth including even dragons, all of which could be seen flying amongst its many branches. G'Hanir died with its mistress Aviana when she was killed by demons of the Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients, and the tree lost all its leaves. However, Aviana set out to restore it in Cataclysm after her resurrection, and as of Warlords of Draenor it seems to be restored, as Aviana sought to invite

The Gadgetzan Times was a web publication by Blizzard but is portrayed as an in-universe newspaper published by Sparkle Entertainment Lightning & Fireworks. Typoe Crunchmode is the editor-in-chief of the Gadgetzan Times. Fizzle Goblinseer is a writer. Sparkle Steamburst is the president of Sparkle Entertainment Lightning & Fireworks. It has recently changed to a fanfic medium, accepting applications on stories and the like.
__NOTOC__ Fused Wiring is an Engineering component that is found in many high level gadgets. It isn't sold by merchants and is usually found after destroying mechanical creatures or target dummies.
Fyr Mistrunner is a tauren bread vendor located at Breads and Grains on the lower rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.

G'eras is a Heroic boss rewards vendor located in the central dome of the Terrace of Light in the neutral Shattrath City. Previously G'eras was located in front of the western alcove in the central dome, but was moved to the walkway above it in Patch 2.4.0 (as the alcove is now used for the portal to the Isle of Quel'Danas). It is protected by several vindicators.
Gaea Seeds are found around Mirkfallon Lake in Stonetalon Mountains.
Furywing's Egg is an egg among eggs that if used with 35 will call down Furywing. The egg can be found in Furywing's Perch in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Fury of 1,000 Fists is an ability used by Pandaren Monk during a Pet Battle.
Gadgetzan Defenders are goblins of Gadgetzan found defending "Flight" Technician Wumble's camp on the southwestern side of the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris during the Demon Invasions.
Gadgetzan Sharpshooters were goblin sharpshooters of Gadgetzan found defending "Flight" Technician Wumble's camp on the southwestern side of the Gaping Chasm in Tanaris during the Legion Invasions.
GG-118 Micro-Jetpacks were sold for by Fitzi Gearwobble and Goldo Fizzcrackle during Island Expeditions.
Fury of the Eagle was a Survival hunter ability granted by Talonclaw.

The Fury of Hellfire trailer is the official trailer for World of Warcraft Patch 6.2: Fury of Hellfire. The trailer shows gloating over his newfound leadership of the Iron Horde and displaying his power to an imprisoned .

G'eras Vindicators are draenei located in Shattrath City. They surround and protect the naaru G'eras.
The GG-36 Rock-It Boosters are found during Island Expeditions.
The Fury of N'Zoth is located at N'Zoth in Ny'alotha, the Waking City as part of the Carapace of N'Zoth encounter.
Gaea Dirt Mounds are located around the Charred Vale in the Stonetalon Mountains.

G-5 CANARYs are mechanical chickens that run around parts of the Loading Room and Train Depot in Dun Morogh during Shadowed Halls and Dusty Cogs. They are apparently used by S.A.F.E. to search for any remaining signs of radiation, as they will periodically say: : During Now With More Mechanical Fowl, one of the possible effects from firing the Prototype Bomber Gun is to launch a G-5 CANARY at the target. The chicken will run around for a few seconds and taunt any nearby enemies before casting an ability called Detonate, thereby exploding and killing all nearby enemies.
Fury Wrappings is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.
Fury Imbued Azerite is an Azerite elemental oozeling located in Island Expeditions.
The Fury Incarnate campaign covers all quests added in patch 10.1.7 as part of the Dragonflight campaign.

Ganking usually implies a player or group of players using overwhelming force to kill an opposing player in Player vs. Player combat. A ganker is most often of a higher level, possesses superior gear, or waits for an opportunity to kill the target, such as when the target is low health or engaged with a mob. Successful ganks usually consist of very short fights and depend on tactics like high burst DPS and the ability to hide, making rogues the archetypal ganker. Areas such as Stranglethorn Vale (known for this reason as "Ganklethorn Vale") and Hillsbrad Foothills are infamous for ganking, as they are locations that naturally overlap differently-leveled characters of opposing factions. The Galvanized Horn drops from Chimaera Matriarchs in Stonetalon Mountains.

Galvan the Ancient is a dwarf quest giver located just south of the entrance to Zul'Gurub in Northern Stranglethorn. He used to spend some time in the mountains of Alterac examining truesilver, and in Booty Bay. He is the leader of the blacksmithing group called the Mithril Order. Over many years, he has gathered a vast amount of knowledge in the field of armorsmithing. When other members of the Order see a blacksmith with the skills and drive to become an armorsmith, they send the student to Galvan for more training. His latest student, Trenton Lighthammer, can be found at Sandsorrow Watch in Tanaris. Although Galvan still remains at his tiny camp close to Zul'Gurub as of the Cataclysm, he

Gakin the Darkbinder is a human warlock located in the Slaughtered Lamb in the Mage Quarter of Stormwind City. His student Surena Caledon stole a Bloodstone Choker from him. During the Burning Legion's third invasion, Gakin traveled to the Dreadscar Rift to join the Black Harvest. He coordinates various warlock missions.

__NOTOC__ Gallows' End Tavern (or Gallow's End Tavern) featured trainers for warriors, priests, mages, rogues, warlocks, enchanters, and first aid. It also had an innkeeper and a few other vendors. This tavern was notable because it is the only fully functional tavern known to be run by the Forsaken. A captured Scarlet Zealot and Dwarven Mountaineer were held in the cellars.

Gamon is an elite named tauren found in the Valley of Strength within Orgrimmar. He can be rescued and will then assist players in The Drag area of the Siege of Orgrimmar raid, where the Gamon Will Save Us! achievement is focused on him. Gamon is well known to many Horde players and is the subject of numerous memes and jokes. Until the Cataclysm expansion, Gamon was level 12 and one of the only Horde-attackable NPCs in Orgrimmar. He was part of an early rogue quest but was primarily renowned for being repeatedly killed for no reason. This familiarity eventually made him an effective symbol of the increasing brutality and racism of Garrosh Hellscream's Kor'kron forces during Mists of Pandaria

Gallows' Corner is a crossroads in the Alterac Mountains, close to the Ruins of Alterac. This area is held by Crushridge ogres who patrol the area around the ruined scout tower. No quests take place here and this area no longer serves any purpose.

Gan'zulah is a jungle troll found in Zul'Kunda in Northern Stranglethorn. Gan'zulah is the leader of the powerful Bloodscalp tribe who are at war with the Skullsplitter tribe. The gnome Osborn Obnoticus and Horde adventures later use the physical remains of Gan'zulah after he is killed to inadvertently resurrect Bloodlord Mandokir.
Gallan Cuffs are a quest reward from To Steal From Thieves which starts with Genavie Callow in Undercity.
Ganoosh is a leper gnome found in the Apothecarium in the Undercity.
